claim_scope: Consumed-case mechanism qualification only; no effectiveness, generalization, SOTA, or Official success claim.
treatment: Incremental Executable Program V1 with separate envbench_shell and apply_environment_step tools

termination.reason: The defining operation-linked path was absent in two cases and activated only once, late, in the third case. The batch was stopped before Official evaluation to avoid spending more model calls on an interface-level failure.

episodes.notable_bypass: Request 3 changed global Git safe.directory through envbench_shell. This was a construction-side effect, not a replayable deployment step.
Request 6 successfully executed python -m pip install -e ".[dev,doc]" through envbench_shell, so a true deployment mutation bypassed the accumulating program.
The defining tool first appeared only after 31 ordinary shell calls; no replay condition was reached.

adjudication.finding: A second shell-like mutation tool is not a natural control surface for this Agent. The Agent retained its learned habit of using the ordinary shell for both diagnosis and persistent environment changes.
adjudication.network_reason: Provider errors retried successfully and all three episodes subsequently received multiple valid model responses. The persistent-operation bypasses occurred after recovery, so network errors do not explain the interface non-activation.
adjudication.next_minimal_change: Use one arbitrary-Bash shell tool with a required per-call semantic annotation distinguishing inspection from a persistent program step. Do not add package rules, command filters, checkpoints, cross-case memory, or a stronger prompt for the rejected dual-tool interface.

evidence.contents: Partial trajectories, container command logs, status records, progress records, and coordinator logs; source and package caches intentionally omitted from the local evidence copy.
